name: Neon Night

background.description: Diagonal purple-to-navy linear gradient with about 12 blurred glowing dots (radial gradients in cyan and magenta, 20-60px) floating upward at different speeds

timer.tickEffect: cyan ring drains clockwise, pulses and turns pink on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: green glow + scale up to 1.08, plus a tick icon
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: fade to 30% opacity and shrink slightly

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 15:1 at the lighter purple stop; correct is much brighter than wrong

name: Sunny Pastel

background.description: Soft cream-to-pink vertical gradient with large semi-transparent pastel circles (yellow, mint, sky blue, 80-240px, 35% opacity) scattered across the frame
background.motion: circles bob up and down gently, 12s loop

timer.tickEffect: orange circle with the digit bounces on every second and grows on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: dark green answer card with white text, burst of pastel confetti
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: fade to 35% opacity with a small sideways wobble

music.mood: playful ukulele and pizzicato, 120 bpm, light claps, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 10:1; correct (dark green) vs wrong (bright coral) differ strongly in brightness; add a tick or cross icon

name: Dark Minimal

background.description: Near-black vertical gradient with a faint radial vignette and a very subtle 1px dot grid at 4% white opacity

timer.tickEffect: large yellow digit fades and slides up each second, turns red on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: thin mint outline wipes left to right around the correct answer and it brightens
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: text dims to 25% and a thin line strikes through it

music.mood: minimal lo-fi electronic with a soft ticking pulse, 95 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 16:1; mint correct is far brighter than red wrong

name: Retro Arcade

background.description: Deep purple gradient with a magenta and cyan perspective floor grid in the lower half (CSS 3D-transformed repeating lines) and a pixel-art sun at the horizon
background.motion: grid lines scroll toward the viewer, 4s loop

timer.tickEffect: scoreboard-style digit flips each second, blinks yellow and red on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: screen shake, green flash border, 'CORRECT!' pixel banner
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options glitch, then drop to 25% opacity

music.mood: 8-bit chiptune, 130 bpm, bouncy arpeggios, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 17:1; use short lines because the pixel title font is wide

name: Paper Craft

background.description: Cream paper color with SVG feTurbulence grain at low opacity and 3 layered torn-edge wave shapes in terracotta, mustard and teal with soft drop shadows at the bottom

timer.tickEffect: paper-cut hourglass drains sand strip, wobbles on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: answer card flips like a paper flap to a green side with a drop shadow
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: card folds down and fades to 30% opacity

music.mood: acoustic folk with light percussion and whistle, 105 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 10:1; dark green correct vs light coral wrong differ clearly in brightness

name: Ocean Breeze

background.description: Pale aqua gradient with three layered SVG sine-wave bands in deeper blues across the bottom third and a few white bubble circles rising
background.motion: waves slide horizontally in opposite directions, 10s loop

timer.tickEffect: blue bar fills with a rippling wave edge and shifts to orange on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: wave wipes across the correct answer, leaving a deep green card
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options sink down slightly and fade to 30%

music.mood: breezy tropical pop-house with marimba, 112 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 11:1; deep green correct vs coral wrong differ strongly in brightness

name: Sunset Glow

background.description: Vertical gradient from deep purple through magenta to orange glow near the lower third, with a large soft sun circle and dark layered ridge silhouettes in SVG at the bottom

timer.tickEffect: thin amber ring with gradient stroke shrinks, glows stronger on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: answer card scales up with a warm yellow glow and a mint check badge

music.mood: warm chillwave with soft guitar, 100 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 10:1 at the lightest magenta stop; mint correct is much brighter than red wrong

name: Space Odyssey

background.description: Dark navy to indigo gradient with a starfield made of 80 tiny white radial-gradient dots in 3 size layers and a soft purple nebula blob made from blurred radial gradients
background.motion: star layers drift at different speeds, twinkle, 30s loop

timer.tickEffect: radar-style circle pulses outward each second, yellow and faster on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: starburst flash behind a mint-outlined answer that scales up
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options drift away and fade to 25% opacity

music.mood: ambient cinematic electronic with soft pulses, 90 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 16:1; mint correct is clearly brighter than pink-red wrong
